name: next_code_point
declaration: unsafe fn next_code_point < 'a , I : Iterator < Item = & 'a u8 > > (bytes : & mut I) -> Option < u32 >
documentation:
Reads the next code point out of a byte iterator (assuming a
 UTF-8-like encoding).

 # Safety

 `bytes` must produce a valid UTF-8-like (UTF-8 or WTF-8) string
rules: For safety, `bytes` must produce a valid UTF-8-like string, meaning a UTF-8 or WTF-8 string.
